gloss: living a life of leisure; carefree retirement

definitions.gloss: living a life of leisure; carefree and self-sufficient living
definitions.explanation: A four-character compound (四字熟語) describing a relaxed, unhurried lifestyle free from worldly pressures. Typically used to describe retirement or a life of comfortable independence.

examples.japanese: {定年後|ていねんご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}りたい→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: After retirement, I want to live a leisurely life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather lives a carefree life in the countryside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{離|はな}れて→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧{悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧だった。
examples.english: It had been a longtime dream to leave work and spend my days in leisurely freedom.

notes:
USAGE:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character idiom). Used as a な-adjective ({悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧) or adverbially ({悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧). Almost always describes a positive, enviable lifestyle. Most commonly associated with comfortable retirement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (a life of leisure)
- {悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧ (to live at leisure)
- {悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}な⟦{老後|ろうご}→老後：15131_rougo⟧ (a leisurely retirement)
- {悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧ (days of carefree living)
